description: An infinitary negation is true under an assignment exactly when its operand is false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_neg.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} [Finite α]
  {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n) (a : α → M)
  (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ.neg a b ↔
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ a b
